description: The file defines the 'Communication' class within the Goteo project, handling functionalities related to communications such as retrieving, validating, saving, and associating communications with projects and languages. It includes methods for listing, validation, project association, and retrieving related data.

classes.name: Communication
classes.description: Represents and manages communication messages within the Goteo system, including CRUD operations, validation, project associations, language handling, and status reporting.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a Communication object by ID, throwing exception if not found.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the communication message content and header based on the template.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Returns a list of communications based on provided filters, supports pagination and count of total.

methods.name: setPromotedProjects
methods.description: Associates projects with this communication, updating the related database table.

methods.name: getCommunicationProjects
methods.description: Fetches associated projects for this communication, including images.

methods.name: getCommunicationProjectsMini
methods.description: Fetches associated projects with minimal details for this communication.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves the communication, including project associations.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns the image associated with the communication's header.

methods.name: getOriginalLang
methods.description: Returns the original language of the communication.

methods.name: variables
methods.description: Provides template variables for communication content.

methods.name: getLangsAvailable
methods.description: Returns available language codes for this communication.

methods.name: getAllLangs
methods.description: Fetches all language versions of this communication.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Calculates and returns the average email open success percentage for this communication.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the communication's sender is active.

methods.name: isSent
methods.description: Determines if this communication has been sent successfully.
